xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5186: File explorer B: explorer pane, tree, git colors, read menu, search UI

plan.title: File explorer B: explorer pane, tree, git colors, read menu, search UI
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: This issue is already the B slice of the seven-way PAN-5183 split (PAN-5185 to PAN-5191). Its surface is one subsystem (the dashboard frontend): about 19 new small files under one new directory, components/explorer/, plus their co-located tests, which push the per-file count past 25. The items are fine-grained and each is independently reviewable; splitting into more sibling issues would separate the tree from the pane that composes it, and neither half would be user-visible alone.

narratives.Problem: The Stage files pane only lists an agent's changed files (FilesPane.tsx). No surface shows a project's or workspace's directory tree, its git state, or lets the operator find a file by name or content.
narratives.Proposal: Repurpose the files pane as the explorer keyed by explorerRootId (project:<key> from the project home, issue:<ID> from the issue tab): a lazy virtualized tree with natural sort, dotfile/ignored handling, git colors and letter badges, live updates through a shared watch hub, debounced git status, a read and git context menu, quick open and content search. Opening a file creates a code pane spec that PAN-5187 renders. All RPC goes through one client seam over PAN-5185's contracts.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code pane renderer, Monaco, autosave, preview tabs, Changes view or conflict banner (PAN-5187).
- No write actions in the menu: New file, New folder, Rename, Duplicate, Delete, undo/redo, drag to move, OS drop, drag to composer (PAN-5190).
- No server code of any kind: no RPC handlers, routes, watcher or contracts (PAN-5185, PAN-5188).
- No download or upload route; the Download item only links to the PAN-5188 route.
- No edit workspaces, edit-workspace banner, Create PR or merge (PAN-5191).
- No git action (Stage, Unstage, Discard) and no write on a project root.
- No keyboard shortcuts or watch handling inside code panes.
- No features/file-explorer.mdx user page (PAN-5191).
- No global keybinding registry and no change to App.tsx or useStageShortcuts.ts shortcuts.
- No folder letter badges and no staged/unstaged split view in the Changed filter.
- No raise of any file-size allowlist cap.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan against parent WI-1 contract names while PAN-5185 is unmerged; the code on main wins after pan sync-main, and every call goes through explorer-rpc.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5185 is the declared prerequisite and the order book runs it first; a single seam makes a rename a one-file change (D-B1).

autoDecisions.summary: This issue adds the 'code' pane type, fields, dedupe, label and icon but no renderer; opened files show the existing PanePlaceholder until PAN-5187 merges.
autoDecisions.rationale: CodePane is parent WI-8, owned by PAN-5187, which plans in parallel; building an interim viewer would be thrown away (D-B3).

autoDecisions.summary: Single click selects; double click, Enter and Open open a code pane. Preview tabs stay with PAN-5187 through the openFileFromTree seam.
autoDecisions.rationale: Preview tabs are FR-7/WI-8 (PAN-5187); one seam keeps the change local (D-B2).

autoDecisions.summary: Reveal line/column travel as explorerRevealLine/Column/Nonce pane fields.
Watch events go through a ref-counted hub with one server subscription per root.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5187 code panes need the same events without a second stream (D-B5).

autoDecisions.summary: Include the Download menu item, linking to the PAN-5188 route; it 404s until PAN-5188 merges.
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent PRD puts Download in this issue and no later child adds it (D-B6).
Parent D-6: the primary checkout is never written (D-B7).

autoDecisions.summary: Changed filter renders a tree synthesized from git status, not from loaded directories.
autoDecisions.rationale: Deleted files and unloaded folders must still show, as FilesPane showed (D-B8).

autoDecisions.summary: Folder priority uses FR-4, not Orca STATUS_PRIORITY.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-4 is the authoritative requirement; Orca lacks conflicted (D-B9).

autoDecisions.summary: Pane-scoped React onKeyDown with preventDefault for Ctrl/Cmd+P and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F.
autoDecisions.rationale: No keybinding registry exists and no global handler uses these keys (D-B11).

autoDecisions.summary: Expand all is capped at 2,000 folders; dotfiles show by default; content search debounces 300 ms at 2+ chars.
autoDecisions.rationale: Defensible defaults that keep a large checkout responsive (D-B12, D-B13, D-B14).

autoDecisions.summary: Project home shows Files only when projectKey is defined.
autoDecisions.rationale: Without a project key there is no project root id to show.

autoDecisions.summary: Stage swap is one item: render switch, files dedupe, IssueOverview root, migration, FilesPane deletion.
autoDecisions.rationale: Splitting it breaks the issue tab Files button mid-branch (D-B15).

items.title: Given fake timers, when three signals arrive 50 ms apart, then run is called once, 125 ms after the last signal.

Given setActive(true), when 60 s pass after a run, then run is called again; given setActive(false), then no safety run happens; when dispose is called, then a pending run is cancelled.

Given explorerGitStatus rejects with NOT_A_GIT_REPO, then the hook returns errorCode 'NOT_A_GIT_REPO' and empty decorations; a later watch signal or 60 s safety tick sends no call; refresh() sends exactly one call.
